title: Seat View
description: Structural schema companion for contract: seat-spheres/v0. A seat view rolls thin per-subject sphere records up into one view of a seat's responsibility: a stable function plus the delegated subjects the seat holds. Only delegated subjects are listed; an unlisted subject is open, not owned. Default decision rights by relation are documented, not encoded. Capabilities are not modeled here; reference them by almanac locator only. Date ordering (expires on or after as_of) is consumer-enforced.

capabilities.description: Host-less capability tokens. Must include the exact opaque seat-spheres contract token.

seat.description: The seat's holder: an agent or a person, never a run.

reports_to.description: Optional agent or person id this seat reports to. Never a run.

function.description: The seat's function. Stable for the life of the seat.

spheres.description: Delegated subjects only. Unlisted means open, not owned, except for subject kinds a consumer treats as closed by default (see the README). Each subject appears at most once; consumers MUST enforce uniqueness of (subject.kind, subject.id).

almanac_locator.description: Optional opaque locator for the seat's capabilities in an almanac. Capabilities are not part of this schema.

subject-id.description: Lowercase subject id. Segments of a-z and 0-9 joined by single '.', '_', '/', or '-'.

person-id.description: Person id. Must not carry the agent- or run- prefix.

actor-id.description: An agent or person id; never a run id.

relation.description: Closed relation of the seat to the subject. Default decision rights per relation are documented in the README, not encoded.

kind.description: Subject kind slug, for example product, repo, surface, or process.

exception.description: An allow widens the defaults and requires a reason. A deny narrows them and may omit it.

right.description: Decision right being overridden, as a slug.

measure.description: A measure attached to one sphere entry. expires is required, so there are no permanent measures.

exceptions.description: Short list of allow/deny overrides to the documented defaults for the relation.

cover.description: Optional single agent or person id that acts for the holder when the holder is unavailable; never a second lead. Never a run.

review_by.description: Optional date by which this sphere entry is reviewed.

no_apply.description: When true, the seat authors changes for the subject but does not apply them.
